### Step 1 — Scene
A cold meal of two vegetable-filled wrap pieces, two sushi pieces, a small Greek-style salad, and orange juice. The wrap filling is partly obscured, so its composition is uncertain.

### Step 2 — Vessels
- Main plate: approximately **22 cm diameter**; area = 3.14 × 11² = **380 cm²**.
- Salad bowl: approximately **19 cm diameter**; area = 3.14 × 9.5² = **283 cm²**.
- Juice glass: approximately **6 cm internal diameter**, with about **9 cm liquid depth**.

### Steps 3–6 — Items, coverage, volume, and weight
Area percentages refer to each item’s own plate or bowl. Wraps and sushi are treated as composite foods, including their fillings.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × average height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Vegetable tortilla wraps, including lettuce, carrot and pale filling/sauce | 44% of plate | 167 × 2.5 = 418 ml | 0.65 g/ml | 272 g |
| Two sushi pieces, including rice, seaweed and filling | 9% of plate | 34 × 2.3 = 79 ml | 0.85 g/ml | 67 g |
| Cherry tomatoes | 14% of bowl | 40 × 2 = 79 ml | 0.60 g/ml | 48 g |
| Cucumber and other chopped greens | 10% of bowl | 28 × 1.5 = 42 ml | 0.65 g/ml | 28 g |
| Dark olives | 6% of bowl | 17 × 1.8 = 31 ml | 0.70 g/ml | 21 g |
| Crumbled white cheese, likely feta | 10% of bowl | 28 × 1.2 = 34 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 32 g |
| Visible salad dressing | 2% of bowl | 5.7 × 1 = 5.7 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 6 g |
| Orange juice | Glass cross-section | 28.3 × 9 = 254 ml | 1.04 g/ml | 265 g |

**Coverage check:** approximately **53% of the main plate** and **42% of the salad bowl’s projected area** contain food. Dressing is assigned a small separate area to avoid double-counting.

### Step 7 — Energy
| Item | kcal/100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---:|
| Vegetable wraps | 190 | 517 |
| Sushi | 145 | 97 |
| Tomatoes | 18 | 9 |
| Cucumber/greens | 16 | 4 |
| Olives | 145 | 30 |
| Feta | 265 | 85 |
| Dressing | 450 | 27 |
| Orange juice | 45 | 119 |

### Step 8 — Sanity check
Estimated **food weight is 574 g**, or **839 g including juice**, providing approximately **890 kcal**. This is plausible for the substantial wrap pieces, two sushi pieces, modest salad and glass of juice. The wraps’ hidden filling and dressing quantity are the largest uncertainties.
